description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the public health endpoint of the Ditto Gateway service, including a method to get cache timeout and an enum of known configuration values with default values.

classes.name: PublicHealthConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for the public health endpoint, primarily a method to retrieve cache timeout.

classes.name: PublicHealthConfig.PublicHealthConfigValue
classes.description: Enum implementing KnownConfigValue, representing known configuration keys and their default values, specifically for cache timeout.

methods.name: getCacheTimeout
methods.description: Returns the cache timeout Duration for external health check information.
